headline: Antwerp's crisis, Charleroi's form — and no away fans
summary: Antwerp have lost 5 league games in a row and sit 13th with just 7 points, which explains why Charleroi are favourites at the Bosuilstadion on Saturday. Charleroi are 3rd with 21 points from 8 matches and have won 4 of their last 5. Antwerp have allowed 3.03 expected goals a game, and Voetbalkrant reports questions over coach Compper's position. Charleroi travel without away supporters after the incidents at Mons, and they have won their last 2 visits to Antwerp. The market gives them a 52.9% chance against Antwerp's 23.9%; the goal line is 2.75 with over at 51%.
read: Charleroi are the clear favourites in Antwerp, rated about two-thirds of a goal the better side and given a 52.9% chance against the home side's 23.9%. Antwerp have lost five straight league games, concede over three expected goals a game and have a coach under scrutiny, while Charleroi have won seven of eight and arrive without any away supporters after the incidents at Mons.

sources.fact: Antwerp coach Compper faces pressure and addressed the possibility of being sacked after a cup defeat, according to Voetbalkrant.
Antwerp advanced in the Belgian Cup against amateur side Heist but the performance was far from good, with coach and players reportedly disagreeing after the match.
Antwerp's Somers admitted the team is not playing its best football right now, saying the most important thing was qualifying.
Voetbalkrant notes Antwerp face Charleroi next, a side of a completely different calibre to their cup opponent Heist.
Wim Smet will referee Antwerp-Charleroi on Saturday at 16:00, with Michiel Allaerts as VAR.
Charleroi announced that the trip to Antwerp on 24 October will be played without away supporters, as a precautionary measure after the incidents at Mons in the Croky Cup.
Charleroi officially condemned the incidents at Mons, including pyrotechnics thrown toward home fans, and decided the next away trip to Antwerp would be without travelling supporters.
The Storm Ultras group stated on Tuesday that Charleroi supporters will not travel to Antwerp this Saturday after the trouble at Mons.
